title: Main Analysis
Main Analysis
text:
Person-Mean Centering
Each night’s sleep is split into the person’s own average and the night’s difference from it.

diary <- read.csv(file.path(site, "data", "diary.csv"))
diary$sleep_mean <- ave(diary$sleep_hours, diary$id)
diary$sleep_within <- diary$sleep_hours - diary$sleep_mean
diary$mood_within <- diary$mood - ave(diary$mood, diary$id)

title: Main Analysis
text:
Within-Person Effect
A model with one intercept for each participant estimates the change in mood for each hour of sleep above the person’s own average.

fit_within <- lm(mood ~ sleep_within + factor(id), data = diary)
round(summary(fit_within)$coefficients["sleep_within", ], 3)

  Estimate Std. Error    t value   Pr(>|t|) 
     0.227      0.033      6.900      0.000 

round(confint(fit_within)["sleep_within", ], 3)

 2.5 % 97.5 % 
 0.162  0.292

title: Main Analysis
text:
Between-Person Effect
A model of each person’s average mood on their average sleep estimates the difference between people.

person <- aggregate(cbind(sleep_hours, mood) ~ id, data = diary, FUN = mean)
fit_between <- lm(mood ~ sleep_hours, data = person)
round(summary(fit_between)$coefficients, 3)

            Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)
(Intercept)    1.804      0.974   1.853    0.069
sleep_hours    0.316      0.140   2.256    0.028

title: Main Analysis
text:
Figure 1
Figure 1 of the paper shows the within-person link. The code saves it in figures/ for the paper and the page shows the saved file.

save_png("figure-1.png", function() {
  plot(diary$sleep_within, diary$mood_within, pch = 16,
       col = adjustcolor("steelblue", 0.4),
       xlab = "Sleep (hours from own average)",
       ylab = "Mood (points from own average)")
  abline(lm(mood_within ~ sleep_within, data = diary), lwd = 2)
})




Figure 1. Daily mood against the night’s sleep, each centered on the person’s own average.

title: Robustness Checks
Robustness Checks
text:
Models
Day 1 of the study was a Monday, so days 6, 7, 13, and 14 fell on a weekend.

diary <- read.csv(file.path(site, "data", "diary.csv"))
diary$sleep_within <- diary$sleep_hours - ave(diary$sleep_hours, diary$id)
diary$weekend <- diary$day %% 7 %in% c(6, 0)

within_estimate <- function(formula, data) {
  fit <- lm(formula, data = data)
  c(estimate = coef(fit)[["sleep_within"]], confint(fit)["sleep_within", ])
}

completed <- table(diary$id)
kept <- diary[diary$id %in% names(completed)[completed >= 10], ]

title: Robustness Checks
text:
Estimates
Each row gives the change in mood for each hour of sleep above the person’s own average, with its 95% confidence interval.

round(rbind(
  "Main model" = within_estimate(mood ~ sleep_within + factor(id), diary),
  "10 or more diary days" = within_estimate(mood ~ sleep_within + factor(id), kept),
  "Study day and weekend" = within_estimate(mood ~ sleep_within + day + weekend + factor(id), diary)
), 3)

                      estimate 2.5 % 97.5 %
Main model               0.227 0.162  0.292
10 or more diary days    0.226 0.160  0.291
Study day and weekend    0.227 0.162  0.292
